settings.heading: One Partner for Every Wedding Gift
settings.intro: We take the many small decisions of wedding gifting off your plate — and put them in the hands of one dedicated concierge.
settings.story:
Weddings involve dozens of gifting moments — return gifts, welcome hampers, family and VIP presents, bridal party boxes. Managing this across many vendors is slow and stressful, and small details slip.

ShaadiGifts brings it all under one roof. We curate and source the gifts, personalise them with your names and theme, pack them beautifully, and deliver on time to your venue — whether it is a hotel in Jaipur or a resort abroad.

We do not run an online shop. Instead, you build a wishlist, share your wedding details, and receive a personalised proposal shaped around your guest list, functions and budget.
